title: Toto, I don’t think we’re in Kansas anymore
content: DAE dream about being in a house that’s being/been lifted up by a tornado or whatever? I can feel it lift off, spin, do cartwheels, and land somewhere else. Not exactly Wizard of Oz style, but doesn’t miss it by much. “Somewhere else” isn’t Munchkinland, but I can’t get home either. Like I just have to make the best of wherever I land. Seems pretty obvious now that I type it out, but the flight is always such a strange sensation
